data.body: STOPPED per anti-90c7 guardrail: Gerrit change 2682 was pushed for review, but its own Verified workflow run https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33989904007 did not include a scanner-integration job in the Gerrit Verified Gate job list. A separate gerrit-scanner advisory workflow did run, but scanner-integration was not part of this change's required Verified aggregate because workflow_dispatch used trusted main's gerrit-verify.yaml. Marked CL 2682 WIP; not submitting. Blocker: co-locating the new job in gerrit-verify.yaml cannot prove non-vacuous execution on the introducing change without an already-landed aggregation mechanism or another safe rollout path.
